# SOP-P2-L3-03 First-article inspection - Machining line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03

Purpose
1. Provide standardized steps to perform first-article inspection for machined forgings produced on the P2-L3 machining line and associated equipment. This procedure ensures dimensional conformance, process parameter verification, and traceable records before production release.

Scope
2. Applies to first-article pieces produced following a setup or change in tooling, material heat, or process program on EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, and EQ-P2-L3-IH03. Use this SOP in conjunction with the maintenance and safety guidance in MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3 and the quality procedures in QS-PROC-09.

Preconditions
3. Material heat certification and furnace charge records reviewed and present.  
4. Machine preventive maintenance status confirmed for EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, and EQ-P2-L3-IH03.  
5. Tooling and fixturing installed and verified to drawing datum features.  
6. Control program loaded and verified against the approved program release.

PPE
7. Required personal protective equipment: safety glasses, hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves for handling billets, steel-toe footwear, and protective sleeve where applicable.

Critical Equipment Parameter Checks
8. Verify the mandrel clamp condition on Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01). The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m. Document measured torque and the tool used.  
9. Confirm billet heating setpoints for induction heater. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 1175 °C. Record actual measured billet temperature and the measurement device identification.

Procedure - Setup and Verification
10. Load program and perform dry-run with fixturing in place. Verify axis limits and collision clearances without part material.  
11. Install first billet and apply identifying tag that references work order and heat number. Verify heat number matches material certification.  
12. Heat the billet in EQ-P2-L3-IH03 to target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 1175 °C, then transfer to the machining station per safe handling practice. Log furnace or heater cycle ID and operator initials.  
13. Mount billet to EQ-P2-L3-RR01 and secure mandrel clamping hardware. Apply mandrel clamp bolt torque using calibrated torque wrench and record applied torque matching mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m. Note any deviations and corrective actions.  
14. Run the machining program to produce first-article part while monitoring process alarms. Pause on any unexpected vibration, finish anomaly, or tool breakage and record event.

Inspection Steps
15. Perform visual inspection for surface condition, scale removal, and gross defects. Note any nonconformance and reference SB-1003 for suspected material defects.  
16. Perform dimensional inspection per engineering drawing. Use calibrated measurement devices and record measurement device IDs. Where tolerance zones are critical, inspect at the datums established during setup. Attach measurement sheets to the first-article record.  
17. Perform metallurgical checks if required by the drawing or material specification. Record sampling location and test method. Refer to QS-PROC-09 for acceptance and disposition criteria.

Rationale and Examples
18. Torque verification on EQ-P2-L3-RR01 ensures mandrel concentricity and prevents axial movement that causes dimensional drift during rolling and machining. Example: a recorded torque below mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m may require re-torque and re-run of the first-article cycle.  
19. Target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 1175 °C establishes starting microstructure and flow properties for consistent machining characteristics. Example: a billet at a lower temperature can lead to increased cutting forces and accelerated tool wear; document and evaluate per QS-PROC-09.

Records to Keep
20. First-article inspection report with: setup checklist, program ID, fixture ID, tooling IDs, mandrel clamp torque record, billet temperature record, dimensional inspection sheet, visual inspection notes, material heat certificate, and operator/inspector signatures.  
21. Calibration certificates for measurement and torque tools used.  
22. Nonconformance reports and corrective action records for any deviations; link to SB-1003 where material anomalies are suspected.

Disposition
23. If all inspection items pass, stamp and sign the first-article record and release the process to production per QS-PROC-09.  
24. If any critical or major deviation is found, stop production, tag the affected parts, and notify engineering and quality. Generate a corrective action per organizational practice and reference SB-1003 and MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3 where applicable.

Sign-off
25. Prepared by: ____________________  Date: ____________________  
26. Reviewed by: ____________________  Date: ____________________  
27. Approved by: ____________________  Date: ____________________

Related documents
28. MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3  
29. QS-PROC-09  
30. SB-1003

Notes
31. Maintain first-article records in the document control system per retention policy. Ensure traceability of each first-article part to its heat number and equipment run.
